scope: The production Mage (Arcane, Fire, Frost, Frostfire) and Warlock (Affliction, Demonology, Destruction) reference requests against 2, 3, 4 and 5 identical copies of the boss: as they are, with area lines (Mage: Blizzard at four targets, Flamestrike, Blast Wave, Cone of Cold and Arcane Explosion at two or more; Warlock: Rain of Fire, or Hellfire, at two or more), for the Fire and Frostfire Mage with a multidot of Fireball, Pyroblast or Frostfire Bolt, for the Warlock with multidot lines for Siphon Life, Immolate, Bane of Agony and Corruption, and for the Destruction build with Bane of Havoc held on the first target while Rain of Fire or Hellfire hits the others, also at one target, each exported with the pinned Go engine and run by Go and Rust.
generator: each request is its base with the one boss target repeated N times in encounter.targets. Bases: validation/2026-10-04-mage-census/bases/BUILD-mage.request.json and fixtures/mage/prepared-v2/production-BUILD-warlock.request.json. BUILD-mage-area-lines-N-targets inserts the Mage lines before the rotation's last item (before its fifth item for Fire, whose unconditional Fireball comes earlier); BUILD-warlock-rain-of-fire-N-targets and BUILD-warlock-hellfire-N-targets insert one cast, condition numberTargets at least 2, before the last item; the multidot requests put multidot lines with no overlap first, one dot spell for the Mage and the four dots for the Warlock; the bane-of-havoc requests start from the request of fixtures/mage/prepared-v2/destruction-warlock-3-targets-bane-of-havoc and cast the bane while it is down, with one area cast second. The application's own BuildRequest was not used, so these area lines are written here, not the application's

criteria.comparison: full RaidSimResult except elapsedNs, lists keyed by ID
criteria.deviations: as variances at the scale of mean^2

notes: Every request matches the pinned Go engine on the whole result and the first-fight log.
